name: femoco
title: FeMoco walk step
description: Controlled FeMoco spectrum-amplified walk circuits under separate estimated and rigorous coefficient-rounding tracks.

components.name: Toffolis per walk step
components.note: Executed CCX and CCZ plus the charge of each Givens rotation, averaged over the sampled lanes.

components.name: Peak logical qubits
components.note: High-water mark of live qubits, system register included.

tracks.name: reiher
tracks.title: Reiher active space (54 orbitals)
tracks.description: FeMoco in the 54-orbital active space of Reiher et al. 2017: 108 spin orbitals.

baseline.note: The construction of Low et al. 2025, the research frontier the challenge starts from, built with its published parameters and validated by this evaluator.

tracks.name: li
tracks.title: Li active space (76 orbitals)
tracks.description: FeMoco in the 76-orbital active space of Li et al. 2019: 152 spin orbitals.

baseline.note: The construction of Low et al. 2025, the research frontier the challenge starts from, built with its published parameters and validated by this evaluator.

tracks.name: reiher-rigorous
tracks.title: Reiher active space — rigorous coefficient error (54 orbitals)
tracks.description: Same stored Hamiltonian and rotation angles as reiher; exact coefficient 1-norm error at most 0.1 mHa. Separate frontier; local promotions await authenticated judge recording.

baseline.note: Rebuilt Low layout at rigorous coefficient precision. No estimated row is relabelled as a rigorous result.

tracks.name: li-rigorous
tracks.title: Li active space — rigorous coefficient error (76 orbitals)
tracks.description: Same stored Hamiltonian and rotation angles as li; exact coefficient 1-norm error at most 0.1 mHa. Separate frontier; local promotions await authenticated judge recording.

baseline.note: Rebuilt Low layout at rigorous coefficient precision. No estimated row is relabelled as a rigorous result.

standard.summary: Estimated tracks retain Low et al.'s estimated coefficient rule. Rigorous tracks use the exact 0.1 mHa coefficient 1-norm rule on the stored Hamiltonian and additionally require deterministic term-pair and alias-boundary coverage. Neither rule is a proof of all-input quantum equivalence or a new bound on the original chemistry/rotation approximation.

build.note: Build knobs are read when build_circuit is compiled. The track sets FEMOCO_WALK_SPEC.

validation.seed: HMAC-SHA256 of the circuit's digests under the ledger key (spec/LEDGER.md)

acceptance.rule: Recorded if valid and it is the first circuit of its architecture, or beats that architecture's best score by the margin, or has fewer Toffolis by the margin than every recorded circuit with at most as many qubits.
